methods.C: one lexical retrieval then one answer call
methods.D: initial lexical retrieval, one follow-up-query call, second retrieval, one answer call

retrieval_protocol.retrieval_engine: SQLite FTS5 BM25, existing unicode61 remove_diacritics 2 index
retrieval_protocol.initial_query: original English bytes; unique first 48 Unicode alphanumeric terms of length >=2 after fixed stoplist; quoted OR
retrieval_protocol.passage: Expand a query-matching FTS5 snippet into a bounded source-text window; preserve source identity and offset
retrieval_protocol.merge: Reciprocal rank fusion constant 60; source identity (collection,point_id); stable source-identity tie order
retrieval_protocol.duplicate_document: Both distinct round windows retained in round order within one shared formatted-document limit
retrieval_protocol.output_cap_note: No synthetic record cap. Provider max_tokens/length failures are retained, with empty records on a length stop.
retrieval_protocol.source_cutoff_reason: Retained live-Qdrant text snapshot lacks a verified identity/content/cutoff equality witness to the frozen TTL graph.
retrieval_protocol.context_token_count: No verified Anthropic tokenizer available here. Log exact characters, UTF-8 bytes and whitespace terms; actual whole-prompt/completion tokens come only from provider usage.
retrieval_protocol.population_completeness: Corpus existence, lexical match count, selected context and requested-answer completeness are distinct. Finite retrieval cannot certify full requested populations.
retrieval_protocol.reuse: Read-only source corpus only; no prior variants, outputs, task selection or reader protocol reused.

information_access.A_B: Separate pinned additive source graph and exact graph-equivalent SQL snapshot.
information_access.C_D: Unchanged bounded lexical retrieval over the retained base corpus plus 64928 generic raw records from every physical Docs/Report file at RAN3#123. Full inventory and available text projections are distinct: all DOCX text parts and workbook worksheets are read, and workbook rows with no authored literal value or formula are excluded from text indexing while their physical inventory is preserved; only exact-member-hash authenticated existing binary-DOC conversions are reused. Unsupported formats, failed text access and tracked text states are explicitly retained in the source-access manifest. No selected answer cells, reference queries, gold, source-positive labels or review judgments enter the raw augmentation.
information_access.paired_source_augmentation: A/B access one additive sourceAuthoredSummary property on 202 final WG-accepted CRs; C/D receive the complete physical report/document inventory's actually accessible raw text, including nonanswers. No physical/temporal whole graph-text equality or identical renderer view is claimed. Literal output scoring is separate from source/provenance correctness; WG meeting acceptance does not establish TSG ratification.
information_access.whole_snapshot_graph_text_date_or_covera: Not established; prior base text/graph cutoffs differ and retrieved context remains bounded.

failure_scoring: Execution failure/abstention F1=0/exact=false; all method items retained. No quality retries.
